My family has called Saratoga home for 22 years, and both of my sons attended our outstanding public schools. Over the years, I have been actively involved in our community through PTA leadership, service on city commissions, and volunteering alongside neighbors who care deeply about Saratoga.
Because of these experiences and my deep love for our city, I’m running for City Council. I want to help ensure Saratoga remains the welcoming, safe, and vibrant community for all residents.
## Focused on What Matters to Saratoga
### Public Safety
✔ Maintain exceptional public safety service while managing costs and balancing budgets, without reducing law enforcement service levels.
✔ Protect our seniors from financial losses due to scam and fraud.
### Housing
✔ Preserve neighborhood character through thoughtful planning and objective design standards.
✔ Develop practical and creative solutions for meeting affordable housing need in the region.
### Fire Safety
✔ Strengthen coordination with regional fire agencies for wildfire preparedness.
✔Create defensible space and manage vegetation around residential properties.
✔ Promote Firewise neighborhoods and public awareness of wildfire alerts and responses.
### Traffic
✔ Implement practical traffic-calming and speed reduction measures to improve safety and protect neighborhood quality of life.
✔ Partner with schools, transportation agencies, and neighboring communities to address traffic challenges.
### Local Business
✔ Promote & support local businesses while preserving historical charm of the city
✔ Collaborate with small business owners and local residents to drive economic vitality in Saratoga Village
### With experience, integrity, and a deep commitment to our community, I will work hard every day to make the best decisions for Saratoga.

## I am grateful for all the endorsements!
“Ping is a hardworking, down-to-earth candidate. She received strong grassroots support due to her years of commitment and service to the community.”
Emily Lo
Former Saratoga Mayor
“I wholeheartedly endorse Ping Li for Saratoga City Council. As a former Mayor and Council member for the City of Saratoga, I know firsthand the importance of thoughtful, principled leadership. Ping has spent multiple years serving our community with dedication, integrity, and compassion. She listens to residents, works collaboratively, and has consistently demonstrated a deep commitment to making Saratoga an even better place to live. Ping brings the experience, wisdom, and sound judgement our city deserves.
I encourage you to join me in voting for Ping Li for City Council.”
Mary-Lynne Bernard
Former Saratoga Mayor
“I first served alongside Ping on the Saratoga Parks and Recreation Commission, and I have had the privilege of continuing that work with her through the Saratoga Rotary Club and the Saratoga Historical Foundation. In all the years I have known her, I have never once doubted how much she cares about this community. She is the kind of person who shows up, quietly and consistently, wherever she is needed.
What I admire most about Ping is the way she listens. She does not rush to judgment. She asks thoughtful questions, takes the time to understand an issue fully, and considers the people it will affect before she ever makes up her mind. She also understands, in a way not everyone does, that real leadership depends on collaboration and on treating people with respect even when perspectives differ.
It is with real pride and affection that I support Ping Li, and I hope you will join me in electing her to the Saratoga City Council.”
Renee Paquier
Former Parks & Recreation Commission Chair
“I'm proud to endorse Ping Li for Saratoga City Council.
As a Midpen docent leading interpretive hikes since 2018, Ping has helped community members connect with nature. On Saratoga's trails committee, she's been instrumental in advancing plans to close the Saratoga to Hakone Gardens and Quarry Park trail gaps which will connect Downtown directly to open space. As a fellow nature lover and land and trail volunteer, I really appreciate these contributions.
Ping's service on the Planning Commission has given her a real grounding in land use and community issues that come before the Council. She's ready and a great choice for Saratoga.”
Craig Gleason
Director, Ward 1, Midpeninsula Open Space
This endorsement is offered in a personal capacity and does not represent the Midpen board or MROSD.
“Ping Li is thoughtful, analytical, and positive. She works well with everyone and respects different points of view.”
Ann Waltonsmith
Former Saratoga Mayor
“I have had the privilege of knowing Ping Li for many years. Our families have volunteered together at our children’s schools, and I have watched her dedication to our community grow into years of public service. Whether serving on the Planning Commission, the Parks and Recreation Commission, or now as Chair of the Planning Commission, she has consistently shown a genuine commitment to making our city a better place. She understands our community because she has been actively serving it for years—with humility, integrity, and hard work.
I wholeheartedly support her candidacy for City Council because I know she will continue to put our community first.”
Katherine Tseng
Board of Trustees, Los Gatos-Saratoga High School
